OpenAI Codex assisted with source extraction, code development, data analysis and writing on October 3, 2026. Computational checks reconcile filtering counts, input hashes, evaluation metrics and published tables. These checks do not establish the accuracy of source industry labels or replace independent review of employer identities and job requirements. The study's conclusions retain those limitations.
